book.subject: 英语
book.edition: 人教版 PEP（三年级起点）

misconceptions.name: by 和交通工具间加了 a/the
misconceptions.why: 记住了“单个的东西前要加 a”，就在 by 后面的 bus 前也加上 a；说交通方式时 by 后面直接跟名词。
misconceptions.move: 对比：by bus（坐公交这种方式）/ take a bus（坐一辆公交），by 后面不加 a、the。

misconceptions.name: 照汉语把两个动词连用
misconceptions.why: 汉语“坐公交车去上学”两个动作连着说，就写成 take a bus go to school。
misconceptions.move: 两种说法选一种：I go to school by bus. / I take a bus to school. 圈出每句里只有一个主要动作词。

misconceptions.name: be going to 漏掉了 be
misconceptions.why: 把 going to 当成“打算”，忘了前面还要 am / is / are。
misconceptions.move: 把 am going to 当成一个整块：I am going to、he is going to，读三遍再造句。

misconceptions.name: to 后面的动词用了 -ing
misconceptions.why: going、liked watching 这类 -ing 说多了，就给 to 后面的动词也加上 -ing。
misconceptions.move: 画箭头：going to → 动词原形，to 后面的动词“回到原形”。

misconceptions.name: 动词三单忘加 s
misconceptions.why: 汉语动词不随“他、她”变化，主语是 he、she 或一个人名时，忘了给动词加 s。
misconceptions.move: 在主语下画一横：是 he、she、it 或一个人？是就检查动词有没有 s。

misconceptions.name: 该加 es 的只加了 s
misconceptions.why: 记住了“三单加 s”，没注意以 ch、sh、s、x、o 结尾的动词要加 es。
misconceptions.move: 读一读 watchs 和 watches：ch 后面加 es，多出一个音节才读得顺；再变一变 wash、fix，o 结尾的 go、do 也加 es。

misconceptions.name: 用了 does，动词还加 s
misconceptions.why: 知道主语是 he 要“加 s”，用了 does 后又在动词上再加一次。
misconceptions.move: 告诉学生：s 只能出现一次——有了 does，动词就回到原形：Does he like ...?

misconceptions.name: 主语是 he/she 还用 do
misconceptions.why: Do you ...? 说得最熟，主语换成 he、she 时没把 do 换成 does。
misconceptions.move: 主语是 he、she 或一个人名，问句开头就用 Does；全班把 Do you / Does he 连起来说几遍。

misconceptions.name: should 后面多加了 to
misconceptions.why: want to、have to 说惯了，就在 should 后面也加上 to。
misconceptions.move: 把 can、should、must 写在一起：它们后面都直接跟动词原形，不加 to。

misconceptions.name: 看到人名加 s，没看时间词
misconceptions.why: 三单加 s 练得很熟，看到主语是一个人就加 s，没注意 last Sunday 说的是过去。
misconceptions.move: 先圈时间词：last、yesterday、ago 一出现就是过去的事——动词变过去式，不管主语是谁。

misconceptions.name: Did 问句用 do 来答
misconceptions.why: Do you ...? Yes, I do. 说得最熟，没注意问句开头已经换成了 Did。
misconceptions.move: 圈出问句的第一个词：用什么问就用什么答——Did 问 did 答，Do 问 do 答。

misconceptions.name: 问过去的事还用 Do 开头
misconceptions.why: Do you ...? 问句说得最熟，问上周、昨天的事时没把 Do 换成 Did。
misconceptions.move: 先找时间：过去的事问句用 Did。把 Do you ... every day? / Did you ... yesterday? 并排读一读。

misconceptions.name: 看到感叹号就当成观点
misconceptions.why: 表达感受的句子常带感叹号，就把感叹号当成判断标准，不看说的内容能不能核实。
misconceptions.move: 追问：这件事能不能查证？看到的人说法都一样吗？能查证的就是 Fact，有没有感叹号都一样。

misconceptions.name: 生病说成 is + 病名
misconceptions.why: 汉语“他发烧了”“我感冒了”里没有“有”，就用 is 把人和病连起来。
misconceptions.move: 说得了什么病用 have / has：I have a cold. He has a fever. 全班用 has 说出三种病。

misconceptions.name: need 后面漏了 to
misconceptions.why: 和 should、can 一起学，以为它们后面都直接跟动词。
misconceptions.move: 把 should eat 和 need to eat 并排写，圈出 to：need 后面跟动作要加 to。

misconceptions.name: 以为心情不好和健康无关
misconceptions.why: 平时说“健康”多指不生病，没把心情好算进健康。
misconceptions.move: 请学生回忆课上说的健康：身体好，心情也好；再请几个人说一个让心情变好的办法。

misconceptions.name: 以为花钱买的都是商品
misconceptions.why: 只记住“用钱买东西”，没区分买到的是一件东西（goods）还是别人为你做的事（services）。
misconceptions.move: 追问：付了钱，你拿回家一件东西，还是别人为你做了一件事？前者是 goods，后者是 services。

misconceptions.name: 每周都做的事用了过去式
misconceptions.why: 前面几个单元一直在练过去式，看到动词就变过去式，没看 every Sunday 这样的时间词。
misconceptions.move: 黑板上画两栏 every Sunday / last Sunday，把句子放进对应的一栏，再决定动词的形式。

misconceptions.name: 以为太阳绕着地球转
misconceptions.why: 每天看到太阳东升西落，就以为是太阳在绕着地球走。
misconceptions.move: 请一个学生当太阳站着不动，一个当地球绕着他走，边走边自转，看“日出日落”是怎么来的。

misconceptions.name: 把月球当成行星
misconceptions.why: 月亮在夜空里又大又亮，以为天上的大天体都是行星。
misconceptions.move: 读一读：The Moon travels around Earth. 绕着太阳转的是行星，绕着行星转的是卫星。

misconceptions.name: 以为地球也是恒星
misconceptions.why: 汉语“星球”“星星”都带“星”，以为 star 指所有天体。
misconceptions.move: 告诉学生 star 是自己会发光发热的，比如太阳；地球自己不发光，是 planet。

misconceptions.name: 独一无二的东西前用了 a
misconceptions.why: 记住了“一个东西前加 a”，没想到太阳、月亮只有一个，要用 the。
misconceptions.move: 问：天上有几个月亮？只有一个、大家都知道指哪个，就用 the：the Sun、the Moon。

misconceptions.name: 以为 green 就是绿颜色
misconceptions.why: 只知道 green 是“绿色”，没想到它还有“清洁、环保”的意思。
misconceptions.move: 问：风是什么颜色？阳光是绿的吗？再请学生说说风能、太阳能为什么对地球好，引出 green 的新意思：干净、环保。

misconceptions.name: 以为绿色能源来自植物
misconceptions.why: 一想到“绿色”就想到树和草。
misconceptions.move: 把风能、太阳能、水能各配一张图，问：它们从哪里来？有没有植物？

misconceptions.name: 旧东西再用一次也叫 recycle
misconceptions.why: 两个词都带 re-，都和旧东西有关，就混在一起。
misconceptions.move: 对比：reuse 是东西不变、换个用法再用（旧瓶子装铅笔）；recycle 是送去回收、做成新东西。

misconceptions.name: 照汉语“关灯”说成 close
misconceptions.why: 汉语“关门”“关灯”都用“关”，就把 close the door 搬到了灯上。
misconceptions.move: 对比 close the door / turn off the light：门窗用 close，电灯、电视这些用电的东西用 turn off。

misconceptions.name: 把 on 和 off 记反了
misconceptions.why: on、off 都很短又成对出现，只记住了“turn + 一个小词”。
misconceptions.move: 配上手势：turn on（打开开关）、turn off（关上开关），老师说、学生做，再反过来。

misconceptions.name: should 后用了过去式
misconceptions.why: 点评里一直在写过去做的事，写到推荐别人时顺手也用了过去式。
misconceptions.move: 圈出 should：后面永远用原形，不管前面讲的是不是过去的事；并排读 I went there. / You should go there.

misconceptions.name: 把 stay up 当成起床
misconceptions.why: 两个短语都带 up，又都和睡觉起床有关，get up 学得早，就把 stay up 也当成“起床”。
misconceptions.move: 对比 get up early（早起）/ stay up late（很晚还不睡），配动作：伸懒腰起床、打着哈欠不睡。

misconceptions.name: 把 up 理解成“在高处”
misconceptions.why: 只认识 up 是“向上、在上面”，就逐词译成“在上面待着”。
misconceptions.move: 把 stay up late 当成一个整块记：晚上该睡了还不睡；请学生说说自己哪天熬过夜。

misconceptions.name: 以为 feel down 是生病
misconceptions.why: 这个单元刚学了 feel ill、have a cold，看到 feel 加一个词就以为在说身体不舒服。
misconceptions.move: 追问：比赛没赢，会让人发烧咳嗽吗？会让人心里怎样？再对比 I feel ill. / I'm feeling down.

misconceptions.name: 把 down 理解成“倒下”
misconceptions.why: 只认识 down 是“向下”，就逐词译成“往下倒”。
misconceptions.move: 画一个向下的箭头配一张难过的脸：心情“往下掉”就是低落；让学生用 I'm feeling down. 说说难过的时候。

misconceptions.name: 几百的 hundred 加了 s
misconceptions.why: 记住了“两个以上的东西加 s”，就在 two、three 后面的 hundred 上也加 s。
misconceptions.move: 对比 two books / two hundred：hundred 前有具体的数不加 s；全班写一写 three hundred、five hundred。

misconceptions.name: forty 多写了 u
misconceptions.why: four、fourteen 都有 u，就以为 forty 也有。
misconceptions.move: 把 four、fourteen、forty 竖着写，圈出 forty 少了 u；全班拼读 f-o-r-t-y 三遍。

misconceptions.name: to 后面的动词也加了 s
misconceptions.why: 记住了主语是三单要加 s，给 want 加了 s 还不放心，to 后面的动词也加上。
misconceptions.move: 画箭头：只有 want 随主语变成 wants，to 后面的动词“回到原形”，和 going to buy 一样。

misconceptions.name: 漏看了 not，意思读反
misconceptions.why: not 夹在句子后半截，读得快就只抓住了后面几个词。
misconceptions.move: 让学生用手指着读，读到 not 停一停：not 后面说的是“不要这样做”。

misconceptions.name: 把“一个一个地”当成“一次”
misconceptions.why: 看到 one 和 time，就拼成了“一次”。
misconceptions.move: 演示：一支一支地把笔放进盒子（one at a time），和一把全放进去（together）比一比。

lessons: What famous places do you know
items.stem: — How was your holiday? — ____
options: Yes, it was. I climbed a hill.
It is great! I climb a hill.
It was great! I climbed a hill.
It was great! I was climb a hill.
right: How was ...? 问过得怎么样，先说感受：It was great!
说假期里做的事，动词用过去式：I climbed a hill.
typical: 问句里有 was，就先答 Yes：
Yes, it was. I climbed a hill.

ladder.q: — How was your trip? — ____（很棒）
补全：I ____ (visit) my grandma last Saturday.
用英语问朋友周末过得怎样，再替他答：很好，我踢了足球。
ladder.a: How was your weekend? It was good. I played football.

lessons: What famous places do you know
items.stem: 用括号里的词填空：Tom ____ (walk) around the lake last Sunday.
right: last Sunday 说的是过去的事，
walk 加 ed：Tom walked around the lake.
typical: Tom 是一个人，动词加 s：
Tom walks around the lake.

ladder.q: 用括号里的词填空：We ____ (watch) a show yesterday.
用括号里的词填空：My cousins ____ (climb) Mount Taishan last summer.
用英语说：上个暑假我们参观了一座博物馆。
ladder.a: We visited a museum last summer.

items.topic: Where did you go 怎么答
items.stem: — Where did you go last weekend? — ____
options: We had some delicious hotpot there.
I went to Hangzhou with my aunt.
I go to Hangzhou with my aunt.
Yes, I did. I went to Hangzhou.
right: Where 问去了哪里，先答地点；
说过去的事用 went：I went to Hangzhou.
typical: 听到 did you，就先答 Yes：
Yes, I did. I went to Hangzhou.

ladder.q: — Where did you go yesterday? — ____（去了公园）
— What did you do there? — ____（我们看了一场表演）
用英语问朋友：去年冬天去了哪里？在那儿做了什么？
ladder.a: Where did you go last winter? What did you do there?

items.stem: 用括号里的词填空：We ____ (see) the old city wall in Xi'an last summer.
right: last summer 是过去；see 是不规则动词，
过去式是 saw：We saw the old city wall.
typical: 过去式就在后面加 ed：
We seed the old city wall.

ladder.q: 写出过去式：eat → ____，go → ____
用括号里的词填空：I ____ (take) a trip to Wuhan last May.
用英语说：我们吃了热干面，还拍了很多照片。
ladder.a: We ate hot dry noodles and took many photos.

items.stem: 补全旅行点评的最后一句：The science centre was so much fun! You should ____ it!
right: 点评里讲经历用过去式，最后推荐别人去用 should；
should 后面跟动词原形：You should visit it!
typical: 前面写的都是过去的事，这里也用过去式：
You should visited it!

ladder.q: 补全：You should ____ (try) the noodles there!
补全：I ____ (walk) around the museum. You should ____ (go) there!
为你去过的一个地方写点评的开头句和结尾句。
ladder.a: 如：My trip to Xi'an was great! You should go there!

lessons: How can festivals bring us together
items.stem: — Did you and your cousins eat jiaozi at the Spring Festival? — ____
right: Did 开头的问句，用 did 回答；
问的是 you and your cousins（你们），答的人说 we：Yes, we did.
typical: Do you ...? 用 do 答，这里也一样：
Yes, we do.

ladder.q: — Did you clean the house? — No, ____ .
— Did your sister paste fu on the door? — Yes, ____ .
用英语问同学：儿童节你去公园了吗？再替他否定回答。
ladder.a: Did you go to the park on Children's Day? No, I didn't.

lessons: How can festivals bring us together
items.topic: 用 Did 问过去的事
items.stem: 国庆节过后，问朋友：你去看望爷爷奶奶了吗？
right: 问过去做没做某事：Did + 主语 + 动词原形？
Did you visit your grandparents?
typical: 说过去的事，动词要用过去式：
Did you visited your grandparents?

ladder.q: 补全：____ you watch the Spring Festival Gala?
变成问句：They watched the fireworks.
用英语问朋友：中秋节你们赏月了吗？
ladder.a: Did you watch the moon at the festival?

lessons: How can big events bring us together
items.stem: — How was the sports meet? — It was great. — What did you like about it? — ____
options: Yes, I did. I liked it a lot.
It was fun. I was very happy.
right: What did you like about it? 问喜欢它的哪一点，
说出具体的事：I liked watching the races.
typical: “喜欢看”就是 liked + watch：
I liked watch the races.

ladder.q: 补全：I liked ____ (sing) with my friends.
— What did you like about the book fair? — ____（喜欢听作家讲故事）
ladder.a: I liked listening to the writer's stories.

ladder.q: 用英语说说你参加过的一次活动：怎么样？喜欢哪一点？
ladder.a: 如：It was great. I liked playing games.

lessons: How can big events bring us together
items.stem: 用括号里的词填空：Last Friday, our class ____ (sing) a song for the teachers.
right: Last Friday 说的是过去的事；
sing 是不规则动词，过去式是 sang。
typical: 过去式就在后面加 ed：
Our class singed a song for the teachers.

ladder.q: 写出过去式：run → ____，make → ____
用括号里的词填空：Last Saturday, Amy ____ (wear) a red dress.
用英语说：昨天老师给我们读了一个故事。
ladder.a: Our teacher read a story to us yesterday.

lessons: How can big events bring us together
items.stem: Tom 读自己写的日记，这样判断。同意吗？
work: Our sports meet began at 8 o'clock!
有感叹号，所以这句是 Opinion。
right: 运动会八点开始，这件事能查证，是 Fact；
Opinion 是个人的看法，如 Races are so exciting!

ladder.q: Fact 还是 Opinion？Amy ran in the race.
Fact 还是 Opinion？Dragon boat races are the most fun!
写一句关于运动会的 Fact，再写一句 Opinion。
ladder.a: 如：We ran a race. It was great fun!

lessons: How do we know we are ill
items.stem: Tom has a runny nose. He should ____ some warm water.
right: should 后面直接跟动词原形，
主语是谁都不变：He should drink some warm water.
typical: 主语是 he，动词加 s：
He should drinks some warm water.

ladder.q: 补全：You should ____ (wear) warm clothes.
补全：She is angry. She should ____ (take) a deep breath.
朋友为考试担心，用 should 给他一个建议。
ladder.a: 如：You should ask your teacher for help.

lessons: How do we know we are ill
items.stem: 用英语说：Lily 发烧了。
right: 说得了什么病用 have / has；
Lily 是一个人，用 has：Lily has a fever.
typical: “发烧了”里没有“有”，就用 is：
Lily is a fever.

ladder.q: 补全：I ____ a bad cold.
补全：My sister ____ a cough.
用英语说：我弟弟咳嗽，还发烧。
ladder.a: My brother has a cough and a fever.

items.stem: 补全：We need ____ enough water every day.
right: need 后面跟动作要加 to，
to 后面用动词原形：We need to drink enough water.
typical: 和 We should drink 一样：
We need drink enough water.

ladder.q: 补全：We should ____ (sleep) well.
补全：You need ____ (eat) healthy food.
用 need to 给爱熬夜的朋友一个建议。
ladder.a: 如：You need to go to bed early.

items.stem: Tom 这样说，你同意吗？
work: Health is only about our body.
Feeling happy is not part of it.
right: 健康不只是身体不生病，也包括心情好；
心情不好时，可以找家人朋友说一说，做做运动。

ladder.q: 哪件事让心情变好？A. watch TV all night  B. talk to your friends
朋友说 I feel sad. 用英语给他一个建议。
ladder.a: 如：You can talk to your family.

ladder.q: 用两句英语说怎样过健康的生活：一句关于身体，一句关于心情。
ladder.a: 如：I run every morning. I talk to my friends.

items.stem: Miss White 说：Don't stay up late. 意思是：
right: stay up late 是熬夜：晚上很晚还不睡；
Don't stay up late. 就是“别熬夜”。
typical: up 和 get up 里的一样，是起床：
不要很晚才起床。

ladder.q: 选一选：I often stay up late. 意思是 A 我常熬夜 B 我常晚起
用英语说：不要熬夜。
用英语给爱熬夜的朋友两条建议。
ladder.a: 如：Don't stay up late. Exercise often.

items.stem: I didn't win the race today. I'm feeling down. 这里的 feeling down 是什么意思？
right: 比赛没赢，心里难过：feeling down 是心情低落；
也可以说 I'm sad. / I feel unhappy.
typical: 这个单元说的都是生病：
feeling down 就是身体不舒服。

ladder.q: 选一选：I'm feeling down. 意思是 A 我很难过 B 我发烧了
朋友说 I'm feeling down. 用英语问他怎么了。
用 should 和 can 各写一句，给心情低落的同学建议。
ladder.a: 如：You should talk to your family. You can join a club.

items.stem: 补全：I ____ a football with my pocket money.（打算买）
right: 打算做某事：am / is / are + going to + 动词原形。
I am going to buy a football.
typical: going to 就是“打算”：
I going to buy a football.

ladder.q: 补全：We ____ going to buy some fruit.
补全：He is going to ____ (play) football this afternoon.
— What are you going to do this weekend? — 去买几本书。
ladder.a: I'm going to buy some books.

items.stem: Lily 这样说，你同意吗？
work: I pay 30 yuan for a haircut.
right: 理发是别人为你做的事，是 service；
书包、食物这些买回家的东西才是 goods。

ladder.q: goods 还是 service？a home delivery
goods 还是 service？a pair of sunglasses
用英语各说一句：你用钱买的一样 goods、付钱的一项 service。
ladder.a: 如：I buy books. I pay for haircuts.

lessons: How can we use money wisely
items.stem: — How much is the bike? — It's ____ yuan.（246）
right: 246 说成 two hundred and forty-six：
hundred 前有 two 也不加 s，forty 里没有 u。
typical: two 是两个，后面加 s：
two hundreds and forty-six

ladder.q: 用英语写出数字：300
用英语写出数字：158
用英语说：这个书包一百四十元。
ladder.a: The schoolbag is one hundred and forty yuan.

lessons: How can we use money wisely
items.stem: 补全：Amy ____ a new bike. She is going to save up for it.（想买）
right: 主语 Amy 是一个人，want 加 s；
want 后面跟动作要加 to，to 后用原形：wants to buy。
typical: Amy 是三单，两个动词都加 s：
Amy wants to buys a new bike.

ladder.q: 补全：Tom ____ (want) to buy a kite.
补全：He wants to ____ (save) up for a football.
用英语说：我妹妹想买一本关于太空的书。
ladder.a: My sister wants to buy a book about space.

lessons: How can we use money wisely
items.stem: 用括号里的词填空：Lucy ____ (buy) a comic book every Sunday.
right: every Sunday 说的是常做的事，用一般现在时；
主语 Lucy 是一个人，动词加 s：buys。
typical: 前面一直在说过去的事：
Lucy bought a comic book every Sunday.

ladder.q: 用括号里的词填空：He ____ (save) money every week.
用括号里的词填空：Tom ____ (walk) to the shop every Saturday.
填空：Last Sunday she ____ (buy) a book. Every Sunday she ____ (save) ten yuan.

lessons: How can we use money wisely
items.stem: 问 Lucy 的妈妈：她每周都存钱吗？选出正确的问句。
options: Do she save money every week?
Does she save money every week?
Does she saves money every week?
Is she save money every week?
right: 主语是 she，问句用 Does 开头；
有了 does，动词用原形：Does she save ...?
typical: she 后面的动词要加 s：
Does she saves money every week?

ladder.q: 补全：— Does he write a spending plan? — Yes, ____ .
变成问句：She buys books with her pocket money.
ladder.a: Does she buy books with her pocket money?

ladder.q: 变成否定句：Tom waits for a sale.
ladder.a: Tom doesn't wait for a sale.

lessons: What can we see in the sky
items.stem: 补全：Look up! ____ is big and round tonight.
right: 月亮只有一个，大家都知道指哪个，
前面用 the：the Moon，同样说 the Sun。
typical: 一个月亮，前面加 a：
A Moon is big and round tonight.

ladder.q: 补全：____ Sun is very hot.
补全：I can see ____ plane and some birds.
用英语说：今天早上太阳很亮。
ladder.a: The Sun is very bright this morning.

lessons: What can we see in the sky
items.stem: 哪一句说得对？
options: The Sun travels around Earth every day.
right: Earth 是行星，绕着太阳转；
月球是地球的邻居，绕着地球转。
typical: 每天看到太阳东升西落：
The Sun travels around Earth every day.

ladder.q: 补全：Earth is a ____ . It travels around the Sun.
补全：The Sun is not a planet. It is a ____ .
用英语说：太阳是恒星，地球是行星。
ladder.a: The Sun is a star. Earth is a planet.

items.stem: — Is there a space museum in your city? — ____
right: Is there ...? 用 there is / there isn't 回答；
a space museum 是一个，用 is：Yes, there is.
typical: 问的是这座城市，就用 it：
Yes, it is.

ladder.q: — Is there a river near your school? — No, ____ .
补全：There ____ a rover on Mars.
用英语问：火星上有树吗？再替对方否定回答。
ladder.a: Are there any trees on Mars? No, there aren't.

items.stem: 用英语说：他们乘飞船去空间站。
options: They go to the space station by a spaceship.
They take a spaceship go to the space station.
They go to the space station in a spaceship.
They go to the space station in spaceship.
right: 坐在飞船里去：in a spaceship，a 不能少；
用 by 说方式时不加 a：by bus、by plane。
typical: “乘飞船”就是 by + 一艘飞船：
They go to the space station by a spaceship.

ladder.q: 补全：My dad goes to work ____ car.
改错：We went to Shanghai by a plane.
ladder.a: We went to Shanghai by plane.

ladder.q: 用英语说：航天员乘飞船回到地球。
ladder.a: Astronauts come back to Earth in a spaceship.

items.stem: 用括号里的词填空：In space, a taikonaut ____ (wash) his face with a wet cloth.
right: 主语 a taikonaut 是一个人，动词用三单；
wash 以 sh 结尾，加 es：washes。
typical: 三单就加 s：
A taikonaut washs his face.

ladder.q: 用括号里的词填空：She ____ (brush) her teeth every morning.
用括号里的词填空：He ____ (watch) the sunrise in space.
用括号里的词填空：Every afternoon the taikonaut ____ (do) exercise.

items.stem: Binbin 想问：雨是从哪里来的？选出正确的问句。
right: 主语 rain 是三单，问句用 does：Where does ...?
有了 does，动词用原形：Where does rain come from?
typical: rain 是三单，come 要加 s：
Where does rain comes from?

ladder.q: 补全：Where ____ electricity come from?
变成问句：Water comes from the sea.
ladder.a: Does water come from the sea?

ladder.q: 用英语问：这些苹果是从哪里来的？
ladder.a: Where do these apples come from?

items.stem: 补全：We use solar power ____ our homes.（给家里供暖）
right: 用某样东西做某事：use ... to + 动词原形，
We use solar power to heat our homes.
typical: 两个动作直接连着说：
We use solar power heat our homes.

ladder.q: 补全：We use electricity ____ (light) our rooms.
补全：We can use wind power ____ (run) trains.
用英语说：我们用水能来发电。
ladder.a: We use water power to make electricity.

items.stem: Solar power is green energy. 这里的 green 是什么意思？
options: 它发出的光是绿颜色的
right: green energy 指清洁、对地球好的能源；
太阳能来自阳光，不是植物，也不是绿颜色的。
typical: green 就是绿色：
它发出的光是绿颜色的。

ladder.q: 说出课上学的三种 green energy。
ladder.a: wind power, solar power, water power

ladder.q: Green energy is green in colour. 对吗？
用英语说：风能是绿色能源，因为它很干净。
ladder.a: Wind power is green energy because it is clean.

items.stem: It's time for bed. 补全：Let's ____ the TV.
right: 关掉电视、电灯这些用电的东西用 turn off；
Let's turn off the TV.
typical: “关电视”的“关”就是 close：
Let's close the TV.

ladder.q: 补全：Turn ____ the computer when you finish.（关掉）
补全：It's dark. Let's turn ____ the light.（打开）
用英语给家人一条节约用电的建议。
ladder.a: 如：We should turn off the TV.

items.stem: Amy 这样说，你同意吗？
work: I keep my toys in an old shoe box.
right: 旧鞋盒没送去回收，换个用法再用，是 reuse；
送去回收、做成新东西，才是 recycle。

ladder.q: reuse 还是 recycle？Use an old jar as a pencil box.
reuse 还是 recycle？Send old paper to make new paper.
用英语各说一个 reuse 和 recycle 的做法。
ladder.a: 如：Reuse old boxes. Recycle old books.

items.stem: 节水小贴士：Wash all the dirty cups together, not one at a time. 意思是：
options: 每个杯子只洗一次就够了
攒够脏杯子一起洗，不要一个个洗
right: together 是“一起”，not one at a time 是“不要一个一个地”；
攒够了一起洗，能省水省电。
typical: one 和 time 就是“一次”：
每个杯子只洗一次就够了。

ladder.q: 选一选：Come in one at a time. A 一个一个进来 B 一起进来
Walk to school. Don't go by car. 用汉语说说这条建议。
用英语写一条节约用电的小贴士。
ladder.a: 如：Turn off the lights when you leave.
